components.name: Primary button
components.description: The filled action for the current workspace view.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; font: 500 14px/20px "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-button { background: var(--accent, #252522); border-color: var(--accent, #252522); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #403f39); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #3675a4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: A neutral action with a fine rule.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; font: 500 14px/20px "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-button { background: var(--surface, #fff); border-color: var(--line, #e4e2db); color: var(--ink, #252522); } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--soft, #ebe9e3); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #3675a4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A softly rounded field with a stronger rule.
components.css: .ds-field { width: min(100%, 260px); box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cecac0); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #252522); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/20px "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #62615b); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #3675a4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Current destination
components.description: An outline icon and label in the current navigation capsule.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav" aria-current="page"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M2.25 12.75V12A2.25 2.25 0 0 1 4.5 9.75h15A2.25 2.25 0 0 1 21.75 12v.75m-8.69-6.44-2.12-2.12a1.5 1.5 0 0 0-1.06-.44H4.5A2.25 2.25 0 0 0 2.25 6v12A2.25 2.25 0 0 0 4.5 20.25h15A2.25 2.25 0 0 0 21.75 18V8.56A2.25 2.25 0 0 0 19.5 6.31h-6.44Z"/></svg> Tasks</button>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 38px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #62615b); font: 550 14px/20px "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--soft, #ebe9e3); color: var(--ink, #252522); } .ds-nav[aria-current] { background: var(--accent, #252522); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #3675a4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Review status
components.description: A green tint, leading dot, and visible review label.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--success-bg, #e2f5ed); color: var(--success, #14634d); font: 500 12px/16px "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-status::before { content: ""; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Task list panel
components.description: A shared panel with ruled task rows.
components.html:
Launch page
Review the mobile layout
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e2db); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #252522); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 2px #2220170b); max-width: 340px; } .ds-task { padding: 16px 20px; font: 650 16px/24px "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-task + .ds-task { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e2db); }

components.name: Workspace metric
components.description: A value beneath a short label and above a fine rule.
components.css: .ds-metric { max-width: 220px; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e2db); font-family: "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-metric dt { color: var(--muted, #62615b); font-size: 13px; } .ds-metric dd { color: var(--success, #14634d); margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 1.8rem; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Public signup link
components.description: A charcoal capsule with an outline arrow for the main signup action.
components.html: Get started
components.css: .ds-public-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 17px; border-radius: 999px; background: #252522; color: #fff; font: 650 .875rem/1.5 "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-public-cta svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-public-cta:hover { background: #403f39; } .ds-public-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #3675a4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Public page navigation
components.description: Inline links with an underline and darker text for the current page. On compact screens, the footer provides links between public pages.
components.html: Agent rolesHow it worksFAQ
components.css: .ds-public-nav { display: flex; gap: 30px; color: #62615b; font: 550 .875rem/1.5 "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-public-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-public-nav a:hover { color: #403f39; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-public-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--public-ink, #252522); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-public-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #3675a4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Public setup panel
components.description: An ordered setup guide with blue outline icons and one fine rule between steps.
components.css: .ds-public-setup { border: 1px solid var(--public-line, #e4e2db); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--public-surface, #fff); color: var(--public-ink, #252522); font: 400 15px/1.5 "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-public-setup h2, .ds-public-setup h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-public-setup h2 { padding: 14px 20px; } .ds-public-setup ol { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-public-setup li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 21px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 14px; padding: 16px 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--public-line, #e4e2db); } .ds-public-setup svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; margin-top: 1px; color: var(--public-accent-text, #28577a); } .ds-public-setup p { margin: 3px 0 0; color: #62615b; }

narrative.overview:
Cowork uses a warm gray frame, white ruled panels, and compact controls to make daily agent work easy to scan. Muted context sits beside titles, actions, and status labels.

The homepage, How It Works, and FAQ share a light canvas, large Instrument Sans titles, outline icons, and quiet borders. Agent portraits introduce the four roles on the homepage and in the setup guide. The FAQ highlights the selected question in blue.
keyCharacteristics: Warm gray frame and softly ruled surfaces.
Charcoal capsules for primary actions and the selected workspace destination. Public navigation underlines the current page.
Instrument Sans throughout, with semantic blue, amber, and green accents.

rules.name: The Status Color Rule
rules.body: Use semantic color on labels and relevant nonzero totals. Preserve the written state in badges so its meaning is legible without color.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation and fine borders for panels and nested sections. The workspace panel shadow is shallow. The public example uses a warmer stage around its nested frame.

dos: Do keep status labels visible alongside semantic color.
Do divide related rows with a shared rule inside a single panel.
Do preserve labels and keyboard focus when navigation moves to a drawer.
donts: Don't use informational blue as the default fill for a primary workspace action.
Don't assign alert color to a zero count in a workspace metric.
